answer: Each agent parks a refundable exit bond; reputation is a pearl that only stays lustrous if renewed by paid work inside each epoch, else it decays like a zephyr. Leaving the terrace is never free: an identity that walks away forfeits the bond, so a sybil who mints aliases pays the full bond per alias while a coalition of operators pays it for every partition they spin up. Cost(n) rises super-linearly for any attacker, single or coordinated, because each fresh identity starts at zero reputation and must re-earn standing under the same decay clock.
